name: contradictory_topic_20ng
description: Oracle first splits a broad topic cluster by domain, then reverses course and merges the two new clusters back, then splits again. Tests that the agent handles contradictory topic-based intent gracefully on 20 Newsgroups news data and keeps producing valid state throughout. Mirrors the contradictory_oracle scenario for cross-dataset comparison.

oracle_turns.raw_text: The science cluster mixes medical posts with space exploration posts. Split it into a 'Medical & Health' cluster and a 'Space & Astronomy' cluster.
Actually, keeping science together is more useful for my analysis. Merge the medical and space clusters back into a single 'Science' cluster.
On reflection, the split is better after all — please separate medical topics from space topics again.
Let's keep the split this time. The current clustering is fine as it is. No more changes.
